title: Concept: Include or require path built from a variable in php — review required
description: In php, include/require resolves a path that is not a literal. PHP executes included files as code, so control over the path is control over which code runs; with remote includes enabled it is also control over the host. The statement looks like ordinary templating, which is why lexical review rules flag every variable-driven include rather than guessing provenance.
applicability: php applications that assemble include paths from request or configuration data.
risk: Local or remote file inclusion leading to code execution; HIGH severity.
